column1: # WinterDash CYD partition table — ESP32-2432S028R (classic ESP32
# Reuses the PROVEN 4MB geometry (identical to esp32-tdisplay-4mb / esp32-wroom32):
# Bakes Battery only (screen+web) -> app comfortably under the 1.8125MB slot. The CUSTOM (user-uploaded) hero
# WORKS E2E here: the 0x50000 storage holds 1 full-quality custom slot
# mmap (microSD was ABANDONED — internal storage instead). Default 64KB .wdb align
# are OVERRIDDEN in board_esp32_cyd.yaml to 48KB/12KB (WD_HERO_CAP=0xC000 / WD_THUMB_CAP=0x3000) -> SLOT_SPAN 252KB (not the default 256KB).
# OTA can't rewrite this table (a slot resize needs a CABLE flash). Per-board: never inherit the 16MB table.
